title: 傑克／聖馬洛開發
summary: 傑克／聖馬洛的官方圖解介紹浮式生產單元與外輸管線；本課比較多來源處理與長距輸送的邊界。本課依序分析外輸管線液相損失、雙來源處理庫存、輸送壓差與功率、處理模組重量、來源分配與出口總量，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Chevron’s public diagram describes Jack/St Malo’s floating unit and export pipeline; this case compares multi-source processing with long-distance transfer. The course analyses liquid losses in export piping, processing inventory for two sources, transfer pressure difference and power, processing-module weight, source allocation and export total, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 外輸管線液相損失、雙來源處理庫存、輸送壓差與功率
v31FocusEn: Liquid losses in export piping; Processing inventory for two sources; Transfer pressure difference and power

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Liquid losses in export piping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δp = f (L/D) rho v²/2；代入 f = 0.02 dimensionless Darcy factor、L = 2115 m、D = 0.3 m internal diameter、rho = 850 kg/m³、v = 1.4 m/s，得 117 kPa（「外輸管線液相損失」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δp = f (L/D) rho v²/2; with f = 0.02 dimensionless Darcy factor, L = 2115 m, D = 0.3 m internal diameter, rho = 850 kg/m³, v = 1.4 m/s the result is 117 kPa (simplified exercise for Liquid losses in export piping; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 142 kPa（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 142 kPa (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 117 kPa（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 117 kPa (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 針對「外輸管線液相損失」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。用同一密度與溫度基準，將兩段長度不同的虛擬管線壓降除以長度比較；再把速度提高一成並檢查平方比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Use consistent density and temperature to compare pressure loss per length for two virtual lines, then raise velocity by ten percent and check the expected squared dependence. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Liquid losses in export piping” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停留時間足夠長就保證所有乳化油水完全分離。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A long residence time guarantees complete separation of every emulsion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「雙來源處理庫存」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。液位看似正常但入口擾動可能使細液滴穿越；如果把總罐容當成有效液容，停留時間會被高估並掩蓋短路流。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Processing inventory for two sources” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Normal apparent level does not prevent inlet disturbances from carrying fine droplets through; treating gross vessel volume as usable liquid volume overestimates residence and masks short-circuiting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
